skill.summary: A fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback that enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot pages via structured commands.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Browser skill.
- Provides Rust-based, fast, headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Supports navigation, structured page snapshots, element interaction (click, type, fill, etc.), and UI testing via concise commands.
- Enables extraction of structured data, programmatic form filling, screenshots, video recording, cookies/storage management, and advanced browser control.
- Includes semantic locators, network request interception, multi-tab/window/frame handling, and JavaScript evaluation.
